content.text:
用文本模式`r`打开的文件的内容可以用**read**方法来读取。

我们在服务器上内置了一个**books.txt**文件，其中包括书籍的标题。让我们来读取该文件并输出内容：
content.text_html:
The contents of a file that has been opened in text mode can be read using the **read **method. We have created a books.txt file on the server which includes titles of books. Let's read the file and output the content:

用文本模式打开的文件的内容可以用读取方法来读取。 我们在服务器上创建了一个books.txt文件，其中包括书籍的标题。让我们来读取该文件并输出其内容。

content.content:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt")
cont = file.read()
print(cont)
file.close()

content.text: 运行代码，将打印该文件的所有内容。
content.text_html:
This will print all of the contents of the file.

这将打印该文件的所有内容。

resolved.title: 读取文件
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reading Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To read only a certain amount of a file, you can provide the number of bytes to read as an argument to the [b]read [/b]function. 
Each ASCII character is [b]1 byte[/b]: [code format="py" codeId="3106"]file = open("/usercode/files/books.txt")
print(file.read([b]5[/b]))
print(file.read([b]7[/b]))
print(file.read())
file.close()[/code]
This will read the first 5 characters of the file, then the next 7.
[note]Calling the [b]read()[/b] method without an argument will return the rest of the file content.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reading Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To read only a certain amount of a file, you can provide the number of bytes to read as an argument to the [b]read [/b]function. 
Each ASCII character is [b]1 byte[/b]: [code format="py" codeId="3106"]file = open("/usercode/files/books.txt")
print(file.read([b]5[/b]))
print(file.read([b]7[/b]))
print(file.read())
file.close()[/code]
This will read the first 5 characters of the file, then the next 7.
[note]Calling the [b]read()[/b] method without an argument will return the rest of the file content.[/note]

content.text:
如果只想读取某文件的指定大小的内容，可以提供要读的字节数作为**read**函数的参数。

> 每个ASCII字符是**1字节**。
content.text_html:
To read only a certain amount of a file, you can provide the number of bytes to read as an argument to the **read **function. Each ASCII character is 1 byte:

要想只读某一文件的某一数量，你可以提供要读的字节数作为读函数的参数。 每个ASCII字符是1字节。

content.content:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt")
print(file.read(5))
print(file.read(7))
print(file.read())
file.close()

content.text: 这将读取文件的前5个字符，然后再读取后7个。
content.text_html:
This will read the first 5 characters of the file, then the next 7.

这将读取文件的前5个字符，然后再读取后7个。

content.text: 调用**read()**方法，不加参数，将返回文件的其余内容。
content.text_html:
Calling the read() method without an argument will return the rest of the file content.

调用**read()**方法，不加参数，将返回文件的其余内容。

resolved.title: 读取文件
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reading Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To retrieve each line in a file, you can use the [b]readlines() [/b]method to return a list in which each element is a line in the file.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3107"]file = open("/usercode/files/books.txt")

for line in [b]file.readlines()[/b]:
    print(line)
    
file.close()[/code]
If you do not need the list for each line, you can simply iterate over the [b]file[/b] variable: [code format="py" codeId="3108"]file = open("/usercode/files/books.txt")

for line in file:
    print(line)
    
file.close()[/code]
[note]In the output, the lines are separated by blank lines, as the [b]print [/b]function automatically adds a new line at the end of its output.[/note]

content.text:
如果想一行一行的读取文件内容，则可以使用`readlines()`方法来返回一个列表，其中每个元素是文件中的一行。

**例如：**
content.text_html:
To retrieve each line in a file, you can use the **readlines() **method to return a list in which each element is a line in the file.

For example:

要检索文件中的每一行，你可以使用**readlines()**方法来返回一个列表，其中每个元素是文件中的一行。

例如：

content.content:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt")

for line in file.readlines():
    print(line)
    
file.close()

content.text: 如果你不需要每一行存储在列表中，也可以简单地在**file**变量上进行迭代：
content.text_html:
If you do not need the list for each line, you can simply iterate over the file variable:

如果你不需要每一行的列表，你可以简单地在file变量上进行迭代。

content.content:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt")

for line in file:
    print(line)
    
file.close()

content.text: 在输出中，各行之间用空行隔开，因为**print**函数会在其输出的末尾自动添加一个新行。

In the output, the lines are separated by blank lines, as the **print **function automatically adds a new line at the end of its output.

resolved.title: 文件字符阅读器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你需要编写一个程序读取某个文件的指定字符数。
输入数字**N**，输出**books.txt**文件的前**N**个字符。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reading Files[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a program to read the given number of characters of a file.
Take a number [b]N[/b] as input and output the first [b]N[/b] characters of the [b]books.txt[/b] file. 
[note]The given code opens the [b]books.txt[/b] file. Use the [b]file[/b] object to read the content of the file. [/note]
resolved.hint_md: 给定的代码打开**books.txt**文件，并使用**file**对象来读取文件的内容。

code_templates.solution_code:
file = open("/usercode/books.txt") 

n = int(input()) 
l = file.read()

print(l[:n])
file.close()
